skill.summary: 小窗幽文学子技能。当用户询问诗词、读书、书法、书单、小说、散文、线装书等话题时激活。提供诗词鉴赏、读书推荐、书法入门指引。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the xiao-chuang-you-literature skill.
- Activates when users ask about poetry, reading, calligraphy, book recommendations, novels, prose, classical books, and related literary topics.
- Provides poetry appreciation (original text, interpretation, modern relevance), book recommendations (notable quotes, suitable readers), and calligraphy guidance (tools, practice tips).
- Features a unique conversational style: connects classic literature to daily life, highlights memorable quotes, and encourages user interaction with reflective questions.
